title: Thunderbird very slow to sync with gmail
creator: anne234
content:
Thunderbird is taking an hour or more to sync incoming mail with gmail. This has just started to happen in the last month - previously sync was almost instantaneous.

Sometimes Thunderbird will display the incoming email subject but not the content, sometimes it will display nothing for an hour or more after the email was received and can be seen in the native gmail app.

This is not consistently happening, sometimes sync will be immediate.
